hero.headline: The local company behind មីបឋម.
hero.description: LM Manufacturing is building a food manufacturing business in Kampong Speu with a local team, a long-term view and a clear focus on Cambodia.
hero.imageAlt: Illustrative noodle production facility image; not the company’s actual factory

overviewText: We are a Cambodian manufacturing company developing instant noodle products and the systems, people and daily operations needed to support them. Our work begins in Kampong Speu and is built around the market we know best: Cambodia.
storyText: មីបឋម is being built one stage at a time. As our company grows, we will share real milestones, approved product information and the people and work behind our progress.
imageAlt: Illustrative instant noodle production line; actual company photographs pending

owner.title: A message from our owner
owner.name: Huon​ Liming
owner.photoAlt: Owner of LM MANUFACTURING CO., LTD. — replace with approved portrait
owner.message: We are building our company for the long term, with quality, responsibility and steady progress at the center of how we work. Our aim is to make food products people can rely on while developing a strong team and a stable manufacturing operation in Cambodia.

mission: To develop practical food products in Cambodia through responsible teamwork, disciplined operations and continuous improvement.
vision: To grow into a trusted Cambodian food company that creates lasting value for customers, employees and local partners.

values.title: Responsibility
values.text: We take ownership of our work, our commitments and the results we create together.

values.title: Care in the details
values.text: Reliable work is built through attention to people, products and the small details that shape everyday results.

values.title: Keep improving
values.text: We learn from each stage, adapt and strengthen the way we work as the company grows.

milestones.event: LM Manufacturing begins a new stage in Kampong Speu, developing local operations and the មីបឋម brand.
